lines.text: When they were few in number,
few indeed, and strangers in the land,
they wandered from nation to nation,
from one kingdom to another.
He let no man oppress them;
He rebuked kings on their behalf:
“Do not touch My anointed ones!
Do no harm to My prophets!”
He called down famine on the land
and cut off all their supplies of food.
He sent a man before them—
Joseph, sold as a slave.
They bruised his feet with shackles
and placed his neck in irons,
until his prediction came true
and the word of the LORD proved him right.
The king sent and released him;
the ruler of peoples set him free.
He made him master of his household,
ruler over all his substance,
to instruct his princes as he pleased
and teach his elders wisdom.

pictures.scene: Edvard Petersen, Emigrants on Larsens Plads - the family waiting on the stone quay with their boxes and wicker baskets set round them, the mother in her black shawl sitting with the baby on her lap holding an orange and the little girl in the pink pinafore and black hat standing at her knee, the two old women in white caps bent together on the chest behind, the young woman climbing the ship's steps and the dark hull and gangway and masts standing up into the grey morning sky, when they were few in number few indeed and strangers in the land, they wandered from nation to nation from one kingdom to another
pictures.name: pd_petersen_landverhuizers

pictures.scene: Michelangelo, The Prophet Zechariah - the old prophet sitting forward on his marble throne with the open book held up in both hands and his white beard falling over the page, the heavy ochre mantle laid over his pale sea green robe and his bare foot set out on the step, the two attendants standing quietly behind his shoulder in the shadow of the stone, he let no man oppress them he rebuked kings on their behalf, do not touch My anointed ones do no harm to My prophets
pictures.name: pd_michelangelo_zacharias

pictures.scene: Juho Rissanen, The Floor Scrubbers - the two barefoot women at work on the boards of the dark room, the one bent right down over her knees with the birch broom in her hand and her headcloth slipping forward over her face, the other standing over her in the white blouse and red striped skirt with her arms held back, the copper pan tipped at the left pouring its thin stream of water down into the tub, he called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food, he sent a man before them Joseph sold as a slave, they bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons
pictures.name: pd_rissanen_schrobsters

pictures.scene: Peter von Cornelius, Joseph Interprets the Dreams of Pharaoh - the old king sitting back on his marble throne under the red damask hanging with the gold crown on his head and his chin resting on his hand as he listens, the long staff laid aslant across him and his sandalled feet set out on the step, the hands of the young Hebrew lifted in explanation at the very edge of the frame, until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right, the king sent and released him the ruler of peoples set him free
pictures.name: pd_cornelius_farao

pictures.scene: Peter von Cornelius, Joseph Makes Himself Known to His Brothers - Joseph standing on the step of his own hall in the long white robe of Egypt and bending right down to take his youngest brother's face in his hand and kiss him, the brothers crowding in behind with their caps and staffs and one of them down on both knees on the marble floor, the open loggia with its arches and the pale city and trees standing beyond, he made him master of his household ruler over all his substance, to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom
pictures.name: pd_cornelius_broeders
